evidence.quote: For the marker gene task, the pipeline is the same but we utilize different image datasets (Lin et al., 2020) as well as different instructions.

decisions.rationale: R1: constructing an instruction-tuning dataset is dataset construction provenance, with no specified data transformation in this element.
